title: Greenpixie's AI Token Methodology: Assessing the Energy, Water and CO2-eq Impact of AI Tokens for Open and Closed Weight Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.33965v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We describe a methodology for estimating the per-token energy cost of cloud-hosted large language model (LLM) inference, separating between input (prefill) and output (decode) tokens. Graphics processing unit (GPU) energy usage is measured during inference benchmarking with open-weights models on a wide range of text-based tasks. The remaining server energy contribution from non-GPU hardware is estimated from the inference wall time. Bayesian linear regression is used to model the relationship between energy per token and LLM size, request traffic, and hardware deployment configuration. Proprietary frontier LLMs of unknown size and deployment are binned into size buckets based on naming conventions and performance priors, and the space of possible LLM configurations is sampled with Monte-Carlo methods to give a representative average energy per token and uncertainty. translated_title: Greenpixie的AI Token方法学：评估开放与封闭权重模型中AI Token对能源、水和二氧化碳当量的影响
translated_abstract: 我们描述了一种估算云端托管大语言模型（LLM）推理中每个Token能耗成本的方法学，该方法将输入Token（预填充阶段）和输出Token（解码阶段）分开处理。在广泛的文本任务上，通过对开放权重模型进行推理基准测试来测量图形处理器（GPU）的能耗。非GPU硬件产生的其余服务器能耗则根据推理墙上时间进行估算。我们使用贝叶斯线性回归来建模每Token能耗与LLM规模、请求流量以及硬件部署配置之间的关系。对于规模和部署方式未知的专有前沿LLM，我们根据命名约定和性能先验将其划分到不同的规模区间，并使用蒙特卡洛方法对可能的LLM配置空间进行采样，从而给出具有代表性的平均每Token能耗及其不确定性。我们还描述了这些能耗测量结果如何可用于……
tldr: 该论文提出了一套估算云端大语言模型推理中每Token能耗、水耗和二氧化碳当量影响的方法学，通过GPU能耗测量、贝叶斯线性回归和蒙特卡洛采样，同时适用于开放权重和封闭权重模型。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a methodology for estimating the per-token energy, water, and CO2-eq impact of cloud-hosted LLM inference for both open and closed weight models, combining GPU energy measurements, Bayesian linear regression, and Monte-Carlo sampling.
